# Prediction Probability Histogram

Create an interactive histogram of predicted probabilities, separated by
observed outcome. The browser controls can show the distribution
relative to either probability thresholds or predicted-positive
classification rates (PPCR).

## Usage

``` r
create_probs_histogram(
  probs,
  reals,
  by = 0.01,
  stratified_by = "probability_threshold"
)
```

## Arguments

- probs:

  a list of vectors of estimated probabilities (one for each model or
  one for each population)

- reals:

  a list of vectors of binary outcomes (one for each population)

- by:

  number: increment of the sequence.

- stratified_by:

  Performance Metrics can be stratified by Probability Threshold or
  alternatively by Predicted Positives Condition Rate

## Value

A browsable HTML object rendered by the vendored `rtichoke_viz` browser
bundle. It can be displayed in the RStudio Viewer, embedded in R
Markdown or Quarto, or saved as a single self-contained HTML file with
[`htmltools::save_html()`](https://rstudio.github.io/htmltools/reference/save_html.html).

## Examples

``` r
create_probs_histogram(
  probs = list(example_dat$estimated_probabilities),
  reals = list(example_dat$outcome),
  by = 0.1
)
.rtichoke-viz-chart {
  overflow-x: auto;
  min-height: 600px;
}

.rtichoke-viz-chart > * {
  display: block;
}

/* Plotly-like interactive legend styling */
.rtichoke-legend {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.rtichoke-legend-item {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  padding: 2px 4px;
  margin: 0;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1;
  color: #2a2a2a;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 2px;
  user-select: none;
  transition: opacity 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease;
}

.rtichoke-legend-item:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #2563eb;
  outline-offset: 1px;
}

.rtichoke-legend-swatch {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 18px;
  height: 12px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.rtichoke-legend-line {
  display: block;
  width: 16px;
  height: 2px;
  border-radius: 1px;
  transition: background-color 0.15s ease;
}

.rtichoke-legend-label {
  font-size: 12px;
}

/* Hidden / disabled state matching Plotly legend muted appearance */
.rtichoke-legend-item[aria-pressed="false"] {
  color: #a0a0a0;
}

.rtichoke-legend-item[aria-pressed="false"] .rtichoke-legend-line {
  background-color: #a0a0a0 !important;
}

}

}

}

}

}

}

/* Performance Table Scoped Styling */

}

}

}

.rtichoke-performance-table__bar {
  position: absolute;
  top: 4px;
  bottom: 4px;
  left: 4px;
  right: 4px;

.rtichoke-performance-table__bar-fill--positive {

}

.rtichoke-performance-table__bar-fill--neutral {

}

/* Subtle Favorable / Unfavorable / Total Color Treatments */

}

  font-weight: 600;

}

  overflow-x: auto;
}

.rtichoke-report__tablist {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #e5e7eb;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.rtichoke-report__tab {
  padding: 0.5rem 1rem;

  border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0;
  transition: color 0.15s ease-in-out, border-color 0.15s ease-in-out, background-color 0.15s ease-in-out;
}

.rtichoke-report__tab:hover {
  color: #111827;
  background-color: #f3f4f6;
}

.rtichoke-report__tab[aria-selected="true"] {
  color: #2563eb;
  border-bottom-color: #2563eb;
  font-weight: 600;
  background-color: #eff6ff;
}

.rtichoke-report__tab:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #2563eb;
  outline-offset: -2px;
}

.rtichoke-report__tabpanel[hidden] {
  display: none !important;
}

.rtichoke-report__tabpanel {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  outline: none;
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .rtichoke-report__nav-list {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }

  .rtichoke-report__tablist {
    flex-direction: column;
    border-bottom: none;
    gap: 0.25rem;
  }

  .rtichoke-report__tab {
    width: 100%;
    text-align: left;
    border-bottom: none;
    border-left: 3px solid transparent;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    border-radius: 4px;
  }

  .rtichoke-report__tab[aria-selected="true"] {
    border-bottom-color: transparent;
    border-left-color: #2563eb;
  }
}

  flex: 1;
  text-align: right;
}

.rtichoke-pd-cell-count {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #0f172a;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.rtichoke-pd-cell-pct {
  font-size: 10.5px;
  color: #64748b;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  min-height: 14px;
}

.rtichoke-pd-cond-option {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.rtichoke-pd-cond-option input[type="radio"] {
  margin: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.rtichoke-pd-cond-option--active {
  color: #2563eb;
}

/* Performance Metrics integration using Performance Table Primitives */
.rtichoke-pd-metrics-container {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 520px;
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
}

.rtichoke-pd-metrics-table {
  width: 100%;
  table-layout: fixed;
}

.rtichoke-pd-metric--emphasized-header {
  color: #009E73 !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
}

.rtichoke-pd-metric--emphasized-cell {
  background-color: #f0fdf4 !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
}

create_probs_histogram(
  probs = list(
    "Prediction Model" = example_dat$estimated_probabilities,
    "Random Guess" = example_dat$random_guess
  ),
  reals = list(example_dat$outcome),
  by = 0.1,
  stratified_by = "ppcr"
)
.rtichoke-viz-chart {
  overflow-x: auto;
  min-height: 600px;
}

.rtichoke-viz-chart > * {
  display: block;
}

/* Plotly-like interactive legend styling */
.rtichoke-legend {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.rtichoke-legend-item {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  padding: 2px 4px;
  margin: 0;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1;
  color: #2a2a2a;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 2px;
  user-select: none;
  transition: opacity 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease;
}

.rtichoke-legend-item:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #2563eb;
  outline-offset: 1px;
}

.rtichoke-legend-swatch {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 18px;
  height: 12px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.rtichoke-legend-line {
  display: block;
  width: 16px;
  height: 2px;
  border-radius: 1px;
  transition: background-color 0.15s ease;
}

.rtichoke-legend-label {
  font-size: 12px;
}

/* Hidden / disabled state matching Plotly legend muted appearance */
.rtichoke-legend-item[aria-pressed="false"] {
  color: #a0a0a0;
}

.rtichoke-legend-item[aria-pressed="false"] .rtichoke-legend-line {
  background-color: #a0a0a0 !important;
}

.rtichoke-operating-point-chart {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.rtichoke-operating-point-content {
  overflow-x: auto;
}

.rtichoke-operating-point-control {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.rtichoke-operating-point-label {
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #374151;
}

.rtichoke-operating-point-value {
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #111827;
}

.rtichoke-operating-point-slider {
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.rtichoke-horizon-chart {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.rtichoke-horizon-control {
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #374151;
  margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
}

.rtichoke-horizon-select {
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem;
  border: 1px solid #d1d5db;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background-color: #ffffff;
  color: #111827;
  margin-left: 0.5rem;
}

/* Performance Table Scoped Styling */
.rtichoke-performance-table {
  font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, sans-serif;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: #1f2937;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__title {
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #111827;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__scroll {
  overflow-x: auto;
  max-width: 100%;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  text-align: left;
  border-spacing: 0;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__header {
  border-bottom: 2px solid #e5e7eb;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__header th {
  padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #374151;
  background-color: #f9fafb;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__spanner {
  text-align: center !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #d1d5db !important;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__spanner--empty {
  background-color: transparent !important;
  border-bottom: none !important;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__table tbody td {
  padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #f3f4f6;
  white-space: nowrap;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 0;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__table tbody tr:hover {
  background-color: #f9fafb;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__model,
.rtichoke-performance-table__population,
.rtichoke-performance-table__evaluation,
.rtichoke-performance-table__identity {
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #111827;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__op,
.rtichoke-performance-table__horizon,
.rtichoke-performance-table__context {
  color: #4b5563;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__metric {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  font-weight: 500;
  text-align: right;
  min-width: 70px;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__cell-text {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__bar {
  position: absolute;
  top: 4px;
  bottom: 4px;
  left: 4px;
  right: 4px;
  pointer-events: none;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 2px;
  z-index: -1;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__bar-fill {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  border-radius: 2px;
  transition: width 0.2s ease;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__bar-fill--positive {
  background-color: lightgreen;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__bar-fill--negative {
  background-color: pink;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__bar-fill--neutral {
  background-color: lightgrey;
}

/* Disclosure column & toggle button */
.rtichoke-performance-table__toggle-header {
  width: 28px;
  min-width: 28px;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.25rem !important;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__toggle-cell {
  width: 28px;
  min-width: 28px;
  padding: 0.25rem !important;
  text-align: center;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__toggle-btn {
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #4b5563;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  line-height: 1;
  transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__toggle-btn:hover {
  background-color: #e5e7eb;
  color: #111827;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__toggle-btn:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #2563eb;
  outline-offset: 1px;
}

/* Detail Row & Confusion Matrix Container */
.rtichoke-performance-table__detail-row[hidden] {
  display: none !important;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__detail-cell {
  background-color: #f8fafc;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0 !important;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__confusion-container {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  max-width: 480px;
  margin: 0.25rem 0;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__confusion-title {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #1e293b;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__confusion-caption {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #64748b;
  margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
  font-style: italic;
}

/* Confusion Matrix Inner Table */
.rtichoke-performance-table__confusion-table {
  border-collapse: collapse;
  width: 100%;
  font-size: 12px;
  background-color: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__confusion-header-empty {
  border: none !important;
  background-color: transparent !important;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__confusion-spanner {
  text-align: center !important;
  background-color: #f1f5f9 !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #cbd5e1 !important;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #334155;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem !important;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__confusion-table th {
  padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #475569;
  background-color: #f8fafc;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  text-align: center;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__confusion-cell {
  padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem;
  text-align: center;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  line-height: 1.25;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__confusion-val {
  display: block;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #0f172a;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__confusion-pct {
  display: block;
  font-size: 10.5px;
  color: #64748b;
}

/* Subtle Favorable / Unfavorable / Total Color Treatments */
.rtichoke-performance-table__confusion-cell--favorable {
  background-color: #f0fdf4;
  border-color: #dcfce7;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__confusion-cell--favorable .rtichoke-performance-table__confusion-val {
  color: #166534;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__confusion-cell--unfavorable {
  background-color: #fef2f2;
  border-color: #fee2e2;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__confusion-cell--unfavorable .rtichoke-performance-table__confusion-val {
  color: #991b1b;
}

.rtichoke-performance-table__confusion-cell--total {
  background-color: #f8fafc;
  border-color: #e2e8f0;
}

.rtichoke-report {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2.5rem;
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, sans-serif;
  color: #1a1a1a;
}

.rtichoke-report__header {
  border-bottom: 2px solid #e5e7eb;
  padding-bottom: 1rem;
}

.rtichoke-report__title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 2rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #111827;
}

.rtichoke-report__nav {
  background-color: #f9fafb;
  border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
}

.rtichoke-report__nav-list,
.rtichoke-report__nav-sublist {
  list-style-type: none;

}

.rtichoke-report__nav-list {

}

.rtichoke-report__nav-item {

}

.rtichoke-report__nav-link:hover,
.rtichoke-report__nav-link:focus {

.rtichoke-report__nav-sublist {

}

.rtichoke-report__section {
  display: flex;

  padding-top: 0.5rem;
}

.rtichoke-report__section-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #111827;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
  padding-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.rtichoke-report__group {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1.25rem;
  padding-left: 0.5rem;
}

.rtichoke-report__group-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #374151;
}

.rtichoke-report__group-title--tab-panel {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

.rtichoke-report__component {
  display: flex;

  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.rtichoke-report__component-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #4b5563;
}

.rtichoke-report__component-content {
  overflow-x: auto;
}

.rtichoke-report__tablist {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #e5e7eb;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.rtichoke-report__tab {
  padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
  font-family: inherit;

  font-weight: 500;
  color: #4b5563;
  background-color: transparent;
  border: none;
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  margin-bottom: -2px;

  border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0;
  transition: color 0.15s ease-in-out, border-color 0.15s ease-in-out, background-color 0.15s ease-in-out;
}

.rtichoke-report__tab:hover {
  color: #111827;
  background-color: #f3f4f6;
}

.rtichoke-report__tab[aria-selected="true"] {
  color: #2563eb;
  border-bottom-color: #2563eb;

  background-color: #eff6ff;
}

  outline: 2px solid #2563eb;
  outline-offset: -2px;
}

.rtichoke-report__tabpanel[hidden] {

}

.rtichoke-report__tabpanel {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  outline: none;
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .rtichoke-report__nav-list {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }

  .rtichoke-report__tablist {
    flex-direction: column;
    border-bottom: none;

  }

  .rtichoke-report__tab {
    width: 100%;
    text-align: left;
    border-bottom: none;
    border-left: 3px solid transparent;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    border-radius: 4px;
  }

  .rtichoke-report__tab[aria-selected="true"] {
    border-bottom-color: transparent;
    border-left-color: #2563eb;
  }
}

/* Prediction Distribution Scoped Styling */
.rtichoke-prediction-distribution {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.rtichoke-prediction-distribution__controls {

  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;

}

.rtichoke-prediction-distribution__control-group {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);

}

.rtichoke-prediction-distribution__select {

}

.rtichoke-prediction-distribution__metric-value {

.rtichoke-prediction-distribution__table {

  max-width: 480px;

.rtichoke-prediction-distribution__table th,

}

.rtichoke-prediction-distribution__cell--total {
  background-color: #f8fafc;
  color: #334155;
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* Enhanced Prediction Distribution Styling */
.rtichoke-pd-controls-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1.25rem;
}

.rtichoke-pd-radio-group {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #374151;
}

.rtichoke-pd-radio-group-label {
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #111827;
}

.rtichoke-pd-radio-options {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.rtichoke-pd-radio-option {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  font-size: 13px;

  user-select: none;
}

.rtichoke-pd-radio-option input[type="radio"] {
  margin: 0;

}

.rtichoke-pd-matrix {
  table-layout: fixed;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 520px;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 12px;
  background-color: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
  border-radius: 4px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.rtichoke-pd-matrix__corner {
  background-color: #f8fafc;

  text-align: left;
  border-right: 1px solid #cbd5e1;

.rtichoke-pd-matrix__col-header {
  padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #334155;
  background-color: #f8fafc;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
  border-right: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  text-align: center;
}

.rtichoke-pd-matrix__col-header--blank {
  background-color: #f8fafc;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
  border-right: none;
}

.rtichoke-pd-matrix__col-header--active {
  background-color: #eff6ff;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #2563eb;
}

.rtichoke-pd-matrix__row-header {
  padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #334155;
  background-color: #f8fafc;
  border-right: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  text-align: left;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.rtichoke-pd-matrix__row-header--blank {
  background-color: #f8fafc;
  border-right: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
  border-bottom: none;
}

.rtichoke-pd-matrix__row-header--active {
  background-color: #eff6ff;
  border-left: 3px solid #2563eb;
}

.rtichoke-pd-matrix__row--active {
  background-color: #f8fafc;
}

.rtichoke-pd-matrix__cell {
  position: relative;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem;
  text-align: center;
  border-right: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  z-index: 0;
}

.rtichoke-pd-cell-bar {
  position: absolute;
  top: 3px;
  bottom: 3px;
  left: 3px;
  pointer-events: none;
  border-radius: 2px;
  opacity: 0.25;
  z-index: -1;
}

/* Stable Typographic Skeleton */
.rtichoke-pd-cell-content {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  width: 100%;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.rtichoke-pd-cell-content--margin {
  justify-content: flex-end;
}

.rtichoke-pd-cell-label {
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #475569;
  width: 22px;
  flex-shrink: 0;

}

.rtichoke-pd-cell-num {

}

.rtichoke-pd-cell-count {

}

.rtichoke-pd-cell-pct {
  font-size: 10.5px;
  color: #64748b;

  min-height: 14px;

.rtichoke-pd-cond-option {

}

.rtichoke-pd-cond-option input[type="radio"] {
  margin: 0;

}

.rtichoke-pd-cond-option--active {

}

/* Performance Metrics integration using Performance Table Primitives */
.rtichoke-pd-metrics-container {
  width: 100%;

}

.rtichoke-pd-metrics-table {
  width: 100%;

}

.rtichoke-pd-metric--emphasized-header {

  font-weight: 700 !important;
}

.rtichoke-pd-metric--emphasized-cell {
  background-color: #f0fdf4 !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
}
```
